bkl.note: A massive scalar acts as a stiff fluid that dominates anisotropic shear near the bounce, quenching BKL mixmaster oscillations and yielding a stable, isotropic-to-good-approximation bounce. Initial aspherical perturbations of 3e-5 produce shear energy ~1e-9 of scalar energy at bounce.
